statement: The World 4 boss Massive Troll is located in Enclave of Eyes at the end of World 4
No quest for Troll keys; the only source is monster drops
Stilted Seekers drop the Troll Key at 1 in 15000 chance
Go offline on your character; killing 15000 offline gives a guaranteed key drop chance
Completing the TV Outpost Colosseum (second World 4 map) usually gives 2-3 keys
Mutated Mush mini boss drops a Troll Key at 1 in 2 chance
These methods give a couple of keys every week
Troll only requires 900 Accuracy to fight him
Need 16500 Accuracy to fight World 4 monsters that must be killed during the Troll fight
Entering the Troll boss room costs 1 key per entrance
Troll does not start the fight until you start attacking him
Troll has a single mechanic Mind Games: random tasks must be completed before his shield drops
Troll has 80 million HP and you get about 3 attacks in between tasks
With enough damage the fight is hilariously easy; low damage may need several tasks
Task: defeat 5 monsters within 20 seconds; he spawns only 1 at a time
This task needs decent movement speed; it is fairly easy but some tasks are annoying
Tasks are hard if you lack stats to move around the map or one-hit monsters
Task: kill a Crab without killing any Soda Cans
Failing a task gives a different task and he heals a small amount
Dice roll task: roll a 6 to fight; failing means another task and he heals about 3 million; luck related
Troll Scales drop at 1 in 8 chance from Normal Mode Troll
Troll Scales are needed to craft Troll Armor obtained from Merit Tasks
Troll Obol drops at 1 in 5000 chance on Normal Mode
Troll Obol gives Weapon Power and basic stats and its misc bonus is +3% to all stats
Troll is a great way to boost overall stats for damage or skills
